column1: # Game profile of ASTLIBRA Revision (Switch, update v393216)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# KEIZO's own engine (no middleware), SDK 16.2.0, NVN. subsdk0 is GLSLC: the game compiles its shaders at run time, so the shader tables hold the
# outputs captured on a device with DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE (hle_glslc.c); a player's Build captures them on the phone (dev.peanuts.build.RuntimeShaders).
# Status: provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py from the survey); memory values not measured, the survey's guess
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# PEANUTS: most of the run-time shaders are compiled at scene changes after the title, not at boot: the build's capture boot (an empty save) presses
# A every 3 s from 8 s on, as Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled's does. NOT SEEN ON A DEVICE: how far it gets in 150 s is not measured

column2: shaders compiled at run time by GLSLC, captured on the device
